C103 powder were produced and underwent characterization to determine particle size distribution (PSD), morphology, density, and chemistry.
As-built, SR, and SR+HIP condition specimens underwent metallographic preparation and evaluation in order to characterize the evolution of the microstructure with respect to material condition.
AM C103 specimens underwent SR heat treatment at 1100 °C in a vacuum of 10-4 torr for 1 hour then furnace cooled to room temperature before removal.
Vacuum Stress Relief (SR) and Hot Isostatic Press (HIP) heat treatment schedules were identified in the literature with the cycles conducted at NASA MSFC.
